contains: Evaluate each of these rules: PY-ZEN-011.

results.summary: Names describe domain concepts (settle, apply_fees, refund_amount).

contains: Evaluate each of these rules: PY-ZEN-012.

results.summary: notify and notify_refund duplicate the same notification logic.

findings.message: notify_refund() repeats notify() line for line, so a change to the webhook has to be made twice.
findings.remediation: Have notify_refund() call a shared _post_notification(payment, kind) helper.

findings.message: send_notification() reimplements retry logic found elsewhere.

contains: Evaluate each of these rules: ACME-API-001.

results.summary: create_payment returns raw exception details to the client.

findings.message: The error response is the raw exception tuple, which leaks internals and gives clients no stable error code. (It also fails: sys is never imported.)
findings.remediation: Catch specific exceptions and return problem(500, "internal_error", "Something went wrong") with the details logged server-side.

contains: Evaluate each of these rules: acme.code.idempotent-payment-endpoints.

findings.message: create_payment() never reads an Idempotency-Key, so a retried request can create a second payment.
findings.remediation: Require Idempotency-Key and store the first response keyed by it.
